scientific_integrity: The analytic theorem is proved for arbitrary finite star size. A supplementary script checks selected exact-rational and finite numerical instances; no finite test is represented as a general proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to a row-stochastic bidirectional star with strictly positive hub-to-leaf weights, no hub self-weight, and unit leaf-to-hub weights; not a claim for general networks or altered median tie conventions.
title: Exact consensus selection and a discontinuous weight threshold on weighted-median stars
